title: F2 - data/presence/<function_id>.json
description: Mechanical presence map. This file makes no correctness claim and the schema forces it: there is no field for a pass, a match or a verdict. Field names are the names the 3.7 procedures read (A3-F1).

efh.keyOrderContract: Emit keys in propertyOrder exactly. Object-valued fields (tests_per_module, module_tests_minus_sibling_count, source_lines_per_module, tests_per_module) are data-keyed and are emitted in ordinal key order per FOUNDATION 2.3 line 160.

efhForbiddenProperties.unit_tests_direct: FOUNDATION 3.7 lines 761-763: 'The test predicate reads tests_in_impl_modules, never the raw unit_tests_direct - the latter includes surface_dispatch.rs's 110 own tests and is inflated for 526 of 541 entries.' The field must not exist in this schema at all, so a tool cannot read it by accident.

surface_name.description: R. Join key. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 306. Read by 3.7 line 672: s := P.surface_name.

oxfunc_tree_clean.description: R. false blocks publication. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 308.

name_match_confidence.description: R. low iff surface name <=3 chars (53 of 541). FOUNDATION 2.6 line 309.

impl_modules.description: R. Id-mention set minus basenames starting surface_dispatch; may be empty (15 entries). FOUNDATION 2.6 line 311. Read by 3.7 lines 716, 721, 725. 3.7 line 763: impl_modules, NEVER mention_modules - the latter puts ~525 siblings on almost every entry.

exclusion_rule_id.description: R. Prose lives in F14 (A3-S7). FOUNDATION 2.6 line 312.

mention_modules.description: R. Unfiltered set, for audit. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 313. NOT read by the warrant or depth predicates - 3.7 line 763.

module_shared_by.description: R. Sibling ids reaching the same module(s). FOUNDATION 2.6 line 314. Supplies the mechanical nearest-measured-relative sentence A-56 (4.2 lines 932-935).

module_shared_by_count.description: R. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 315. Read by 3.7 lines 727-728, the D2/D3/D4 test-depth predicate.

tests_in_impl_modules.description: R. #[test] count over impl_modules. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 316. Read by 3.7 lines 717, 718, 726. 3.7 line 761: this field, never unit_tests_direct.

tests_are_module_level.description: R. const true. No per-function test count exists in OxFunc. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 317.

tests_per_module.description: R. module -> count, ordinal key order. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 318.

module_tests_minus_sibling_count.description: R. module -> (#[test] count - ids mapped). Negative means at least that many siblings cannot have a test of their own. Required rendered field (A1-F2). FOUNDATION 2.6 line 319. Read by 3.7 line 719 (rendered with W2).

lean_modules.description: R. Files under formal/ naming the id. Means 'a file exists', nothing more. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 321.

declared_vs_scanned.description: O. Omitted entirely when absent. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 325.

doc_mention_classification.description: R. Per mentioning file. Decided by a declared file-name and section-header rule stated in F14. This is what makes HARMEAN's best sentence generated rather than typed (A3-F2). FOUNDATION 2.6 line 327.

scan_inventory.description: R. Required rendering field for W0/W1/W2 and D0/D1; it had no schema slot before A3-F2. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 330.

searched_where.description: R. The human-readable list the absence block renders. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 331.

limits.description: R. Limit IDS only ['L1'..'L9']; prose in F14 (A3-S7). Guard G-12: every id here must be defined in F14 and every F14 id must be referenced. FOUNDATION 2.6 line 332.
